MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Financing Authority,
  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, Housing
  Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*

  February 11, 2025
A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the Library
Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Ruesch at 5:00
p.m., on February 11, 2025, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted by 5:00
p.m. on February 6, 2025, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. A copy was also posted at the
Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive and Norman P. Murray Community
and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Goodell
  Council Member Vasquez
  Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum
  Mayor Ruesch

Absent:  Council Member Kelley

Staff Present:  Elaine Lister, City Manager
  Jerry Hill, Assistant City Manager
  William P. Curley, City Attorney
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk
  Renata Winter, Assistant City Clerk

RECESS AND RECONVENCE MEETING

At the hour of 5:00 pm Mayor Ruesch recessed the meeting. Mayor Ruesch reconvened the meeting at
6:00 pm with four City Council Members present (Council Member Kelley was absent.)

 INVOCATION: Mayor Ruesch

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum

 PRESENTATIONS

 P1.  Mission Viejo Animal Services Presentation

  Received presentation from Brynn Lavison, Director of Animal Services.
City Council Minutes  1  February 11, 2025
  P2.  Waste Management Presentation

  Received presentation from Waste Management Representatives Muyisa Kasomo and Irene
  Penir.

 P3.  Proclaim February 11, 2025 as "2-1-1 Day"

  Presented proclamation to Delia Van Kampen, Director Operations 211 OC, of Orange
  County United Way.

 Mayor Ruesch gave a brief update on several of the goals he established for the City at the beginning
 of the year.

 PUBLIC COMMENTS

 Fahima Karim, M.V.: Spoke on behalf of the Community of Character Committee and introduced the
 word of the month, Unity. She outlined some of the positive features of the character trait that make
 Mission Viejo a better place.

 CONSENT CALENDAR

 Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum. seconded by Council Member Goodell to approve the
 Consent Calendar as outlined below.

 On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

 AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Ruesch, and Vasquez
 NOES:  None
 ABSENT:  Kelley

 1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of January 28, 2025, as presented
  or as amended.

 2.  General Check Register Dated January 17, 2025, in the Amount of $2,977,501.86

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

 3.  General Check Register Dated January 24, 2025, in the Amount of $1,123,588.73

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

 4.  Golf Check Register Dated January 17, 2025, in the Amount of $26,515.50

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

City Council Minutes  2  February 11, 2025
  5.  Golf Check Register Dated January 24, 2025, in the Amount of $17,164.03

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

 6.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for December 2024

  Received and filed.

 7.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA) Treasurer's
  Monthly Report for December 2024

  Received and filed.

 8.  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency Treasurer’s Monthly Report
  for December 2024

  Received and filed.

 9.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for December
  2024

  Received and filed.

 10.  Transmittal of Pre-PARE Trustee Report for the quarter ending December 31, 2024

  Received and filed the accompanying Pre-PARE Trustee Report December 31, 2024.

 11.  2022 Residential Resurfacing—Asphalt Repairs and Asphalt Overlays (CIP 23838)—
  Notice of Completion

  (1) Certified the completion of and accept the improvements for the subject project; (2)
  authorized the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (3) authorized the City Clerk
  to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and to release the faithful
  performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively, after the date of
  recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens being filed with
  the City; and (4) authorized the release of the final retention 35 days after the date of
  recordation of the Notice of Completion.

 12.  Annual Maintenance Program for the Repair and Reconstruction of Streets, Drainage
  Channels, Storm Drains, Slopes, Emergency Response and Heavy Equipment

  (1) Approved Fifteenth Amendment to the existing contract to Bistline Engineering, Inc.; and
  (2) authorized a Change Order to the existing Purchase Order to Bistline Engineering, Inc. in
  the amount of $220,000.00.

City Council Minutes  3  February 11, 2025
  13.  Re-Classification of El Toro Road Between Marguerite Parkway and Cielo Entrada

  Adopted Resolution 25-02 Approving an Amendment to the Circulation Element of the
  Mission Viejo General Plan to Modify the Circulation Element Map to Reclassify El Toro
  Road Between Marguerite Parkway and Cielo Entrada, from a Major Arterial (6-Lane
  Roadway) to a Primary Arterial (4-Lane Roadway).

 ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

 MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

 14.  Orange County Local Agency Formation Commission (LAFCO) Report

  Received written report.

 CITY MANAGER REPORTS

 Nothing to report.

 CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS

 Nothing to report.

 COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

 15.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  By consensus, the City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars
  as presented in the report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the public
  record.

 Council Member Goodell

 Council Member Goodell had no comments this evening.

 Council Member Vasquez

 Council Member Vasquez had no comments this evening.

 Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum

 Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum encouraged residents to attend the Night Market this coming Saturday,
 themed Love Fest with live music and local crafts. She also mentioned sandbags are available at
 seven locations within the city.

City Council Minutes  4  February 11, 2025
  Mayor Ruesch

 Mayor Ruesch stated he met with Assembly Woman Kate Sanchez with regards to Homeowners
 Insurance and her potential involvement. He closed the meeting with a simple thought ~ don’t wish
 for easier, wish for you to be better.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 6:35 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session, Mayor
Ruesch adjourned the meeting to Tuesday, February 25, 2025, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________
Renata Winter, Assistant City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of February 25, 2025

City Council Minutes  5  February 11, 2025
